rationale: First-cut design from hand equations: I_tail=50uA (mn4=5, mn3=3), I_2=100uA (mn5=10) for total current ~180uA; balance condition S_mp3/S_mp1 = 4 = 2*S_mn5/S_mn4 satisfied with mp1=3, wp1=1u, mp3=6, wp3=2u; ln=lp=90nm for gain > 200 V/V; mn1=8, wn1=2u for gm1 ~ 0.8mS; Cc=1.2pF and Rc=800ohm for UGBW > 100MHz and PM > 60deg.

Second hand design addressing p2 and UGBW: ln1=45nm to boost gm1; mn4=4 (I_tail=40uA), mn5=12 (I_2=120uA), mp3=12*1.5u to boost gm6 and p2; Cc=0.8pF to raise UGBW>100MHz; Rc=1200ohm to push zero into LHP for PM boost. Expect UGBW>80MHz, SR>30V/us, PM>55deg.

mp3 6->12, mp1 3->6 (keeping balance S_mp3/S_mp1=4), res 800->1200: double mp3 width to boost gm6 from 1.13mS to ~1.6mS and p2 from 17.9MHz to ~25MHz; Rc=1200ohm pushes zero into LHP; expect PM 31.9 -> >50 deg and UGBW 29.8 -> >40 MHz.
cap 1.2pF->0.8pF: reducing Cc increases gm1/(2pi Cc) and slewRate (I_tail/Cc); expect SR 29.57 -> >40 V/us, UGBW 32.96MHz -> >45 MHz, and area to decrease.
